messages:
megan: FYI staging -> EU push got quarantined by publish checks. cosign verify failed due to unexpected KMS key id. tagging hold for now, ccing @nate @oliver

deploy-bot: publish blocked for image: eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime/staging:20240301-5f2c9a
reason: cosign verify FAILED (key id mismatch)
logs:
```
ERROR: verify: signature verification failed
expected key id: rk-2024-us
found key id: cust-legacy-01
attestation: present
```

nate: which agent did the push? we had the mirror-agent beta rolled to eu canary earlier. could be a config leak.

megan: push came from mirror-agent-eu-2. registry metadata shows layer digests identical; signature header contains cust-legacy-01.

oliver: mirror-agent had a recent env var override to support customer mirrors. looks like COSIGN_KEY was set globally in that rollout.

ivy: confirmed: `mirror-agent-config` contains an override line: `COSIGN_KEY=/run/secrets/customer_cosign` pushed at 2024-03-01T09:12.

megan: decision: HOLD promotion to staging. we will not promote this tag to canary. plan: pull by digest from central, re-sign with canonical key, re-push to eu. @release-manager hold the EU change window.

nate: ops runbook snippet: `k8s-image-promote --env=staging --image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34 --pin` (will pin digest after republish)

megan: manual republish steps:
1) `crane pull eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34 -o runtime.tar`
2) `crane tag runtime.tar eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime:staging`
3) cosign sign using KMS key `projects/redwood-kms/keys/release-key-2024` (kid=rk-2024-us)
4) push and run `deploybot publish` check

deploy-bot: queued manual re-sign job id=rb-2024-98; auto-publish suppressed until manual OK. please update release notes after successful republish.

oliver: fallback if republish fails:
- label release with `hold`
- scale down canary and stop new canary promotions
- rollback to pinned digest if necessary (`@sha256:ab12cd34`)
- create INFRA ticket to prevent mirror agents from overriding COSIGN_KEY at rollout time

megan: I executed the republish using the canonical key and re-triggered the publishbot. cosign verify output now:
```
VERIFIED: signature for eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34
key id: rk-2024-us
status: OK
```

ops-bot: monitoring: canary-eu latency spike at 11:47 during the retry, now stabilized. no error-rate increase.

nate: updating release notes: "staging image republished to EU with canonical signing key; original push was blocked due to mirror agent env override." also creating INFRA-4567 to lock COSIGN_KEY in mirror config.

megan: adding a short postmortem line to the release board. marking this release as held until we observe EU for 2h with no regressions.

release-manager: acknowledged. GA hold in place; will reassess after monitoring window.

deploy-bot: publish succeeded: image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:ab12cd34; event=publish.complete; duration=135s
